summary: Botpress-derivative client defaults credential-bearing traffic to hardcoded.ru endpoint
details: Package @holocronlab/botruntime-runtime is an undisclosed rebuild of the Botpress runtime (bundled source map paths reference github.com/botpress/botpress and github.com/botpress/skynet) republished under an unrelated scope with no upstream attribution in the README. Its exported `client`, documented as an 'authenticated Botpress client', reads Botpress-shaped credentials from environment variables BP_TOKEN / ADK_TOKEN and, when ADK_API_URL is not set, defaults the API base URL to https://botruntime.ru — a domain that is not owned by Botpress. Callers who install this package under the impression that it is Botpress-compatible and populate BP_TOKEN/ADK_TOKEN will transmit those tokens as Authorization credentials to botruntime.ru on every client call. The relay is hardcoded, non-obvious given the Botpress framing, and directed to an author-controlled third-party destination rather than infrastructure the installer configured.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
